backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister with an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping deployment and smoke‑test features to related files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files including App, Moments page, animations, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to deploy the Love Slides app to ICP mainnet using DFX with prerequisites and setup steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, dark‑mode variables, and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/SMOKE_TEST.md: Manual production smoke‑test checklist covering UI flows, transitions, buttons, pages, and expected results.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component implementing the romantic message carousel, final‑slide logic, love transition, and Moments navigation.
frontend/src/components/LoveTransitionOv: Floating‑emoji full‑screen overlay that runs a timed transition and invokes a completion callback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth context and provider handling login, stored identities, and status management.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive OKLCH color variables for light/dark romantic themes plus custom animations like floating hearts and heartbeat.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and an Internet Identity provider, importing global styles and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Moments.tsx: Renders a romantic-themed photo gallery page with animated hearts, styled backgrounds, a message card, and a back button.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, romantic palettes, fonts, container settings, and extended animations and utilities.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature list, and configuration for the Love Slides project’s state tracking.
